title: Recruitment access matrix
summary: Starts the single Recruitment menu work by writing down who can see and use each part of Recruitment.
changes: Document which Recruitment pages and menu items each kind of account can use.
Keep one shared list of Recruitment permissions for menus, permission checks, and tests.
Add the Human Resources job role to the product glossary.
version_rationale: Minor: opens the 0.41 line for the unified Recruitment menu. This release itself changes no behaviour.
validation: composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Menus and permissions still follow the old two-menu layout until later 0.41 releases.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
